system.description: At the start of a session, roll +Omens: on a 7+, lose all Omens and the GM will describe a vision or portent that points toward your fate and/or clarifies your current situation; also, on a 10+, ask the GM a follow-up question and get a clear, helpful answer; on a 6-, don't mark XP, hold +1 Omen, and tell us of your recent nightmares or a troubling vision, and how your fears play into them.

success.value: Lose all Omens. The GM will describe a vision or portent that points toward your fate and/or clarifies your current situation, and you ask the GM a follow-up question and get a clear, helpful answer.

partial.value: Lose all Omens. The GM will describe a vision or portent that points toward your fate and/or clarifies your current situation.

failure.value: Don't mark XP. Hold +1 Omen, and tell us of your recent nightmares or a troubling vision, and how your fears play into them.
